title: Pairwise Learning Increases Data Efficiency in Deep Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.27669v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks often fail at small-sample regression, collapsing to low-variance predictions that miss individual differences. Here, we introduce a pairwise comparison framework that reframes regression as aggregated relative rankings. This method improves data efficiency across model architectures and dataset sizes. On the UTKFace dataset (23k images), pairwise learning generates over one billion training comparisons without additional supervision. The paired ranking allows a lightweight ResNet10 trained from scratch on home hardware to achieve a 3.64-year MAE-surpassing previous models, including those with large-scale pretraining. For classification into categories, pairwise supervision consistently outperforms an otherwise identical 10-way crossentropy model on STL10 with 500-2000 labeled examples, improving accuracy by up to 5.2%. translated_title: 成对学习提高深度神经网络的数据效率
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络在小样本回归任务中常常失败，会退化为低方差的预测而忽略个体差异。在此，我们引入了一种成对比较框架，将回归问题重新构建为聚合的相对排序问题。该方法在不同模型架构和数据集规模下都提高了数据效率。在UTKFace数据集（2.3万张图像）上，成对学习在无需额外监督的情况下生成了超过十亿个训练比较对。这种成对排序使得在家庭硬件上从零开始训练的轻量级ResNet10达到了3.64年的平均绝对误差（MAE），超越了以往模型，包括那些使用大规模预训练的模型。在类别分类方面，成对监督在STL10数据集（仅有500-2000个标注样本）上始终优于其他条件完全相同的10类交叉熵模型，准确率最高提升5.2%。总体而言，成对监督提升了数据效率，使得在有限数据下也能实现强大的回归和分类性能。
tldr: 该论文提出成对比较学习框架，将回归问题转化为相对排序任务，无需额外监督即可大幅提升深度神经网络在小样本回归和分类中的数据效率，使轻量级ResNet10在家庭硬件上训练即可超越大规模预训练模型。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a pairwise comparison learning framework that reframes regression as relative ranking, dramatically improving data efficiency in small-sample regression and classification, enabling a lightweight ResNet10 trained on home hardware to outperform large-scale pretrained models.
